description: Napoleon J95 (later sweep, audit R4; napoleon D56: one core PR, then a pin bump) found seven small faults in the discovery tools, core files since napoleon J64: exe.py mask_for and a fixed-byte floor in search; unclosed files in lua_api.py; db.py mark byte and empty tables in the README; discovery check reads used_by; briefpaths.py Registry gaps exempts only bullets' own path field; shader_catalog.py import skips a missing capture and density reads paths from a file; discovery ui fails loudly without the extract. Raised: napoleon J95, 2026-11-07
title: Discovery tools: seven small fixes for napoleon J95
